mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuation and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of months where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the annualized inflation rate (computed from CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.5%, the Federal Reserve is likely to implement restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of months where CPIAUCSL 12m change exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST and RSAFS growth fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment expansion regime (UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth exceeding 100k), strong labor market conditions support corporate earnings growth and drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of months meeting the regime condition (UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 100k).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment (UNRATE) and acceleration in job growth (PAYEMS) signals a tightening labor market that boosts corporate hiring and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (UNRATE decline and PAYEMS growth acceleration) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.5, it signals a contraction in manufacturing and services output, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of months where INDPRO falls below 100.5.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals robust residential construction and consumer confidence, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of months where HOUST increases by at least 0.5% from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) relative to historical averages signals an accommodative monetary policy environment, which supports equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of months where FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%.
